info.title: Kini Webhooks
info.description: Webhooks Kini sends to your endpoint for real-time updates on application, job, and booking events. Endpoints and the headers Kini sends are configured per company in the Kini Partner App.

post.description: Sent when an application has finished synchronizing to the company's ATS. Kini POSTs this payload to the endpoint you configure, with the HTTP headers you provided at setup. Kini does not sign the payload (there is no Kini-Signature header); authenticate the request via the header/token you configured. Return any 2xx status to acknowledge; non-2xx retryable responses (429/500/502/503/504) or timeouts are retried up to 3 times with exponential backoff (~1s, 2s, 4s), 20s timeout.

company_id.description: The unique Kini ID of the company.

partner_id.description: The unique Kini ID of the partner.

application_id.description: The unique Kini ID of the application.

job_id.description: The unique Kini ID of the job the application was submitted for.

partner_company_id.description: The partner-specific ID of the company, if provided at company onboarding.

partner_application_id.description: The partner-specific ID of the application, if provided at application creation.

status.description: The current synchronization status of the application.

failure_error.description: Error details if the synchronization failed, otherwise null.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2xx status to confirm receipt.

post.description: Sent when a job is created, updated, or archived in the connected ATS. Kini POSTs this payload to the endpoint you configure, with the HTTP headers you provided at setup. Kini does not sign the payload (there is no Kini-Signature header); authenticate the request via the header/token you configured. Return any 2xx status to acknowledge; non-2xx retryable responses (429/500/502/503/504) or timeouts are retried up to 3 times with exponential backoff (~1s, 2s, 4s), 20s timeout.

company_id.description: The Kini company ID the job belongs to.

external_id.description: The job's ID in the connected ATS.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event happened in the ATS.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2xx status to confirm receipt.

post.description: Sent when the status of a job booking changes. Kini POSTs this payload to the endpoint you configure, with the HTTP headers you provided at setup. Kini does not sign the payload (there is no Kini-Signature header); authenticate the request via the header/token you configured. Return any 2xx status to acknowledge; non-2xx retryable responses (429/500/502/503/504) or timeouts are retried up to 3 times with exponential backoff (~1s, 2s, 4s), 20s timeout.

company_id.description: The unique Kini ID of the company.

partner_company_id.description: The partner-specific ID of the company, if provided at company onboarding.

booking_job_id.description: The unique Kini ID of the job the booking was made for.

booking_id.description: The unique Kini ID of the job booking.

booking_job_title.description: The title of the job booking.

booking_product_name.description: The name of the product purchased for this job booking.

booking_url.description: The URL of the job booking once published. Empty for new bookings until published.

booking_status.description: The current status of the job booking.

transaction_id.description: The unique transaction ID associated with the job booking.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2xx status to confirm receipt.
